newsitem.title: USA: Forest now owns 66 percent of Saxon shares.
newsitem.headline: Forest now owns 66 percent of Saxon shares.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said Thursday that pursuant to its Equity Participation Agreement with Saxon Petroleum Inc, it has exercised its right to purchase from Saxon's treasury an additional 158,142 common shares and 2,380,608 non-voting convertible shares.
As a result of the purchase, Forest now owns approximately 87.4 million, or about 66 percent, of Saxon's outstanding 43,958,142 common shares and 43,470,774 non-voting convertible shares.

Forest also said it is fully supportive of Saxon's recently announced bid to purchase Truax Resources Corp and intends to purchase additional shares of Saxon Petroleum in connection with this transaction.
